title: braid-gate result v2 delta (draft fragment, not a standalone result schema)
description: Describes only what v2 changes relative to the committed SPEC-052 v1 result schema (specs/052-claude-workflow-gate/contracts/braid-gate-result.schema.json, schemaVersion agent-braid-claude-gate-result/v0.1). v1 has additionalProperties false at the top level and in request, so v2 is a new schemaVersion and a strict v1 validator rejects it by design. Compose by overlaying these members (including the extended assurance constants) on a copy of the v1 schema and moving $defs to its root; the x-v1-* annotations are non-validating notes. Draft, blocked by G0, adopted by nothing.

schemaVersion.description: Replaces the v1 constant. Emitted only when transcript inputs were supplied; with none, the gate emits the v1 result unchanged (schemaVersion v0.1).

assurance.description: Replaces six constants of the v1 assurance block so that the declared contract matches what a v2 result contains (Article 13). compatibilityClass and notAGuarantee are unchanged and repeated for explicitness. The v1 constants remain the valid ones for a v1 result, which is emitted whenever no transcripts are supplied. Overlay on properties.assurance.properties of the v1 schema; additionalProperties false and the required list of v1 are kept.

property.const: File-level interaction classes and pairwise merge-tree outcomes over committed work, plus read/write hazards inferred from the requested tool calls recorded in subagent transcripts with partial coverage; heuristic evidence, not semantic commutation, hunk-level merge safety, order independence or independence.

evidenceMethod.const: Existing read-only analyzer report through plugin MCP analyze-work, git merge-tree --write-tree baseline in a temporary object directory, and replay evidence through plugin MCP analyze; commands are executed by agents and returned under strict schemas, not independently re-run by the script. In addition, the bundled converter analyze-claude-transcripts maps the supplied subagent transcripts (the host's record of requested tool calls) to Agent Interaction Metadata through the mapper claude-subagent-transcript-v1, and the same read-only analyzer reports their read/write hazards; the conversion is run by the analyze-phase agent and returned under a strict schema, not independently re-run by the script.

domain.const: Committed Git work of at most 32 operations in one registered analysis-only workspace; replay and prepare only for 2 to 4 operations. Transcript evidence only for the supplied subagent transcripts of those operations (at most 32 transcripts, 32 MiB per transcript, 1 MiB per line, 512 distinct paths per agent), mapped with partial coverage; other hosts, live capture and agents without a supplied transcript are outside the domain.

const: Sources are committed work and the base is an ancestor of every source.
The registered workspace repository root equals the repository the agents inspect.
Agent-reported command results match what the commands produced.
The host permission allowlist of REQ-016 is in force; it is recorded by host receipts, not verified by the script.

Each supplied transcript is the host's record of the agent that produced the matching source commit (matched by ordinal); the transcript line schema is unconfirmed until it is pinned from the pre-freeze census.
The Bash allowlist of REQ-016 for gate v2 contains exactly one additional launcher subcommand, analyze-claude-transcripts; it is recorded by host receipts, not verified by the script.

observationContract.const: Pinned base and source commit identifiers, analyzer coverage and interaction classes, per-pair merge-tree result, replay digests, prepare outcome and end-of-run reference re-resolution; absent observations are null and never mean clean. Transcript evidence adds, per agent, the conversion status, the mapper pin, aggregate tool-call and loss counts and per-pair read/write hazards with partial coverage; a transcript records requested calls, not observed effects, and a missing, failed or partial transcript is reported in transcriptEvidence and never means no hazard.

executionContract.const: Read-only analysis and a non-allocating prepare step; no grant, execution, edit, ref write or applied merge; executionAuthorization is false. The converter reads local transcripts without network access or model invocation and creates only its own new private output files at explicit paths outside the source repository; transcript hazards never change status, replay or preparation.

request.description: v1 request members unchanged; adds an echo of the transcript inputs as counts and flags only, never the supplied paths.

analysis.description: v1 analysis unchanged; each element of analysis.interactions gains one optional member. The v1 left and right are operation instance identifiers; the gate uses the same identifiers as the transcript conversion instance identifiers so the two pair sets join exactly.

unobserved.description: Replaces the v1 requirement (uncommitted-work, reads, transcripts). v2 requires uncommitted-work, reads and tool-calls; transcripts is listed only for an agent whose transcript was not mapped. Reads stay unobserved: they are known only as requested calls.

limits.description: Replaces one canonical v1 limit and adds three; seven v1 limits are kept verbatim. The v1 maximum of 16 entries is unchanged.

contains.const: File-level resources only; coarser than hunk merging; a read plus a write on one resource counts as conflicting.
Only committed work is observed; uncommitted work in any worktree is not observed.
Deletions, renames, binaries and symlinks are unknown effects with partial coverage.
Replay, preparation and the owned runtime are limited to four operations; analysis is limited to 32.
No speed, throughput or agent-count claim; parallel runtime speedup results are recorded NO-GO (SPEC-021 G4, SPEC-022, SPEC-038).
Host approval and auto mode are not authority; executionAuthorization is false; grants are issued by the operator outside the workflow.
An independent-candidate, clean or certified outcome is not a guarantee of semantic correctness, conflict freedom or order independence.
Reads are known only as tool calls requested in subagent transcripts, with partial coverage; they are not observed, and transcript read/write hazards are heuristic evidence, not proof.
Transcripts record requested tool calls; Bash, search and MCP effects are invisible and stay unknown.
Independence is never concluded from transcripts; a transcript-derived pair is conflicting, ordered or unknown, never independent-candidate.
Transcript-derived paths are sensitive metadata and are republished only when the operator opts in; status, replay and preparation reflect commit-level evidence only.

x-v1-replaced.unobserved: requires transcripts -> requires tool-calls instead; transcripts only for unmapped agents

limits.removed: Reads are not observed; read hazards are outside this gate.

assurance.rule: v1 constants stay valid for a v1 result (no transcripts supplied); a v2 result carries the extended constants and a v2 payload carrying the v1 constants is rejected, so the declared contract cannot omit the transcript evidence the result contains

x-v1-unchanged: phases (five fixed entries; conversion is folded into the analyze-phase agent and its outcome is reported only in transcriptEvidence)

retention.description: Product retention label. Not aggregate-only: that label is the G0 probe's stricter rule.

analyzerClassification.description: Never independent-candidate: transcript coverage is always partial.

resourcesRepublished.description: True only when the operator opted in to republishing transcript-derived paths.

resources.description: Present only when resourcesRepublished is true. Shared repository-relative paths; bounded; sensitive metadata.

unknownShare.description: Share of transcript tool calls classified unknown (bash, search, mcp, other), as two integers. Does not replace or redefine the commit-level unknown share or the G0 C3 attribution coverage.
